notes.title: Patch 0.3.3
notes.notes:
Slyders has received a lot of feedback recently, especially since Steam Next Fest, and this patch addresses many of the issues and ideas players shared. 



Patch 0.3.3

New runes: Stun Damage, Revive, Reroll, Boomer

Handcannon is now dual-wielded by default

Dash is now a default skill

New pickup: Overdrive - vastly increases fire rate for a limited time. Replaces dual weapon pickup if the equipped weapon is already dual-wielded by default

Improved weapon sounds for Handcannon, Tommygun, and Shotgun

Improved Handcannon model

Increased default player speed

Replaced inventory character image with animated model

Video settings: support for more resolution options

Slightly easier to hit with the Handcannon

After the end boss appears, other enemies will continue to spawn

BUG FIXES

Fixed inaccurate missile launcher aiming

Fixed input button selection screen always appearing on level-up with equipped action runes

Fixed UI glitch on the weapon screen with unlocked weapons

Fixed mouse sensitivity being tied to framerate

Fixed error with shuriken spawning before exiting a game

notes.title: Patch 0.3.1
notes.notes:
Slyders is designed to capture the fun and silly action of a Saturday morning cartoon, and this update enhances the vibrant colors and artistic style across the environments, enemies, and beyond.

- Redesigned enemy textures, level visuals, and UI elements to align more closely with the originally envisioned cartoon style.
- Items no longer need to be purchased with crystals to keep them permanently.
- Forge: items no longer need to be of the same slot type to be combinable. An item can be upgraded by combining 2 other items of the same rarity.
- Selling items now grants crystals instead of gold.

BUGFIXES
- fixed enemies sometimes not spawning anymore while overwhelmed 
- fixed enemies sometimes not spawning when in 'overwhelmed' state 
(note: there still seem to be issues with this sometimes that will be fixed in later patches)
- fixed dash not hitting enemies correctly 
- fixed weapons stop shooting after level-up 
- fixed items not correctly saved after upgrade in forge

notes.title: Patch 0.2.1
notes.notes:
This build has a lot of stuff and moves Slyders closer to a releasable and polished state, which is why I increased the build number from 0.1.x to 0.2.x. 
The focus is on general polish in all areas, some new features, and necessary additions like settings, localization, gamepad support, etc. A lot of work also went into new maps, enemies, and content for the release version, but here in the patch notes, I will only list things that are noticeable in the demo.


added Forge: items of the same type can be combined to increase their rarity
reworked Upgrade screen: it is now a skill tree that can also unlock new perks
localization for English, Chinese, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish
added Gamepad support (I could only test this with Xbox Wireless Pad, so please tell me if you have any issues with others)
most features like menus, skills, weapons need to be unlocked by completing achievements
new Perks: sandworm Sandy, frog fighter Freddy (not in demo), Power Sword (not in demo)
added chest demons: they sometimes spawn and drop gold and crystals. Catch them before the time runs out. Bosses no longer drop crystals.
UI/HUD graphics rework. Some new art (like the perk images) was AI generated to better match the cartoon style of the game. Feel free to post your feedback.
reworked settings menu with more options
added screen resolution, fullscreen toggle
updated music and polished sounds and mixing
